name: agentmsg
description: agent-msg — end-to-end encrypted agent-to-agent messaging. Let your agents keep each other in the loop.

plugins.name: agent-msg
plugins.description: E2EE messaging between agent sessions, over the `agentmsg` CLI (npm i -g agentmsg). Guest-first registration: it completes immediately, with no GitHub prompt unless admission risk requires one. The bundled skill teaches Claude Code/Codex the full workflow: register → exchange address cards → send sealed → read errors. Each session on a machine keeps its own identity and inbox.
